Name: Simple World Tiers (Progression and Difficulty)
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#F2C879]✦ Simple World Tiers ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]Version 1.23 — Statue placement fix[/color][/heading]
Repairs existing owned statues that became unplaceable after removing and reinstalling SWT. Existing ownership, unlocked and selected tiers, milestone counters and reserve are preserved. Update your current edition and reload your save; no reset is needed. Available for both Standard and Hardcore—install one edition only.


[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🔮 A stronger farm. A tougher world.[/color][/heading]
Give your late-game farm something new to work toward. Five magical skill statues turn your accomplishments into higher World Tiers, bringing faster production, more XP and richer rewards—alongside higher costs and tougher challenges.
Choose a separate tier for [b]Farming[/b], [b]Fishing[/b], [b]Foraging[/b], [b]Mining[/b] and [b]Combat[/b]. Each skill progresses from [b]Normal[/b] through [b]Tier V[/b], so you can choose the mix of rewards and difficulty that suits your farm.

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]✨ Features[/color][/heading]

• Five skill statues, each with its own tier progression.
• Cumulative activity milestones and one-time tier unlocks.
• Faster supported machines, increased XP and additional resources.
• Faster crop and tree growth, quality bonuses and extra fruit.
• More expensive seeds, greater tool energy costs, harder fishing and tougher monsters.
• Skill-coloured menus with thick gold Stardew-style beveled borders.
• Clear Requirements, Rewards and Drawbacks, with Simplify and Detailed views.
• Configurable machine colours, optional tier lettering and timing information.
• Standard and Hardcore downloads, optional SSE integration and all twelve game languages.
[heading][color=#C8B0F4]🗿 How To Begin[/color][/heading]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53457/53457-1791344168-989075004.png[/img][/center]
1. Reach native level 10 in a skill to qualify for its statue.
2. Check your mail the following morning for a letter from the Wizard.
3. Place the statue and interact with it to open the World Tiers menu.
4. Complete the displayed requirements, then pay to unlock and activate the next tier.
Each skill has its own statue and cumulative milestones. These include harvesting crops, catching different fish, gathering forage, collecting hardwood, producing bars, exploring mines and defeating monsters. Unlock tiers in order; the menu shows your progress toward every requirement.
Only one valid statue of each skill takes effect. An unused statue can be picked up. After selecting a tier, its statue becomes permanently anchored, including after returning to Normal. You can still hit it with a heavy tool to push it one tile onto a valid empty space.
[heading][color=#8FDAC0]⚖ Five Skills, Five Trade-Offs[/color][/heading]
[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🌱 Farming[/color][/heading]
Faster crop growth and repeat harvests, more harvest XP, eligible quality improvements and faster supported farming machines. Higher Farming tiers increase seed purchase prices.
[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🐟 Fishing[/color][/heading]
More fishing XP, eligible quality improvements and faster supported fishing machines. Fish movement becomes more difficult while retaining each fish’s movement pattern and your existing bait and tackle benefits.
[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🌳 Foraging[/color][/heading]
More wood and hardwood, foraging XP, eligible quality improvements, faster young-tree growth, extra fruit and faster supported natural-product machines. Axe swings consume more energy.
[heading][color=#8FDAC0]⛏ Mining[/color][/heading]
More eligible mining resources and XP, plus faster supported furnaces and refining machines. Pickaxe swings consume more energy.
[heading][color=#8FDAC0]⚔ Combat[/color][/heading]
More combat XP and additional ordinary monster-loot rolls. New encounters have more health and damage, and fresh eligible combat floors receive extra monsters.

[heading][color=#F2C879]📊 Tier Rewards At A Glance[/color][/heading]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53457/53457-1791344179-1734341600.png[/img][/center]

Each reward applies to its corresponding skill’s supported activities. Quality improvements respect iridium and supported custom caps. Fractional resource bonuses are rolled, so individual actions can vary.
At Tier V, ordinary monster loot gets one guaranteed additional data-table roll, with a 5% chance of a second. Kill XP, quests and special scripted rewards are not repeated.

[b]🔥 Standard Tier Drawbacks[/b]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53457/53457-1791344190-2091161743.png[/img][/center]

Tool energy increases apply after normal skill savings. Efficient tools remain free, and bombs have no added tool energy cost. Fishing adds movement difficulty without adding extra catch-progress loss or inflating the fish’s original XP value.
Extra monsters appear once on supported fresh Mines, Skull Cavern and Volcano combat floors. The 20-monster-floor examples are shown in the comparison above. Safe placement, protected special floors, a maximum of 16 added monsters and a 64-monster total limit can reduce that number. Re-entering or switching tiers does not add another batch.
[heading][color=#F2C879]💰 Unlocking & Switching Tiers[/color][/heading]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53457/53457-1791344206-2029793911.png[/img][/center]
Each tier has its own one-time price and milestone requirements. Unlocking a tier also activates it, with no additional switching fee.
Changing to a different [b]already-unlocked[/b] tier costs [b]100,000g[/b] after confirmation, including returning to Normal. Your unlocked tiers and milestone progress remain earned. Normal adds no World Tier bonuses or drawbacks to future supported actions.
[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🌾 Crops, Trees & Fruit[/color][/heading]
New crops remember their [b]planting World Tier[/b]. Their SWT growth, regrowth, harvest XP and quality benefits follow that tier throughout their lifetime, including repeat-harvest crops. Switching tiers later does not upgrade an existing Normal crop or rewrite its stored schedule.
Crop growth applies native and supported skill bonuses before SWT’s reduction. Normal seasons, watering and growing conditions still matter. Seed surcharges are paid at native gold shops; planting has no extra fee, and seeds from the Seed Maker or rewards have no purchase surcharge.
Foraging tiers improve young ordinary-tree and fruit-sapling growth while retaining native clearance, season and fertilizer rules. Mature fruit-tree aging and its quality schedule stay unchanged.
[b]Extra fruit on a successful native production day[/b]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53457/53457-1791344216-27170271.png[/img][/center]
Fruit trees still follow their normal seasons and the three-unpicked-fruit limit. Collecting fruit daily makes room for the full Tier V bonus.
[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🤝 Simple Skills Extended Support[/color][/heading]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53457/53457-1791344237-358392723.png[/img][/center]
[b]SSE is optional.[/b] SWT works on its own and supports both the Level 100 and Level 30 editions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53458]Simple Skills Extended[/url]. SSE provides personal skill rewards; SWT provides the farm’s selected tiers.
[b]Vanilla levels and SSE rewards are separate.[/b] Your unbuffed vanilla skill levels remain capped at 10. SSE grants its own rewards above that level; SWT adds the selected tier’s rewards and drawbacks. Temporary buffs, professions and Mastery keep their normal roles.
With SSE installed, once all five native skills reach level 10, XP beyond a skill’s first 15,000 uses the SSE XP bonuses below. The examples show how much XP a base award of 100 becomes.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53457/53457-1791344249-337251518.png[/img][/center]

These replace SWT’s ordinary XP rates. At Tier V, 100 base XP becomes 360 SSE XP.
Resource bonuses add independently to the original native drops. For example, SSE +200% stone and SWT +105% stone give an expected 4.05× the original quantity. The two mods do not repeatedly multiply each other’s bonus drops. Their supported growth, loot and quality effects also retain their own rules.

[b]🎛 Make It Your Own[/b]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53457/53457-1791344263-1267340613.png[/img][/center]

Open [b]Settings[/b] beside Close at the top right of any SWT tab. This menu works without Generic Mod Config Menu; optional GMCM exposes the same saved choices.
• [b]Simplify / Detailed:[/b] Simplify is the default, showing concise rewards and drawbacks. Detailed adds explanations. Requirements, prices and progress remain visible in both.
• [b]Machine Tier Lettering:[/b] An independent checkbox, off by default, for showing each machine’s actual tier.
• [b]Machine Colours:[/b] Default, Off, All Copper, All Iron, All Gold or All Iridium. Default follows the actual tier’s material; Off restores loaded original body colours.
• [b]Show Timing Information:[/b] On by default, with supported production and crop timing details.
Supported machines automatically use their corresponding skill tier’s processing speed. No upgrade kit is needed in either public edition. Cosmetic machine colours and lettering do not change the actual tier or processing speed.
[heading][color=#9ACAF7]💎 Choose Your Download[/color][/heading]
[b]Standard — Main Download[/b]
The reward and drawback values shown above, with automatic supported-machine speed.
[b]Hardcore — Optional Download[/b]
Keeps Tier I unchanged. Tiers II–V have double the unlock gold, higher milestone requirements and 50% stronger tool-energy and monster health/damage penalties. Tier V Axe/Pickaxe energy is +225%. Rewards, seed surcharges, fish movement and extra-monster targets match Standard.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53457/53457-1791344280-340454217.png[/img][/center]

[b]Install only one edition.[/b] Both downloads use the SimpleWorldTiers folder and the same mod identity.

[heading][color=#C8B0F4]📦 Requirements & Installation[/color][/heading]

• Stardew Valley 1.6 on desktop.
• [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.4.0 or newer.
• Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
• Optional: Simple Skills Extended for extended-skill integration.
1. Choose Standard or Hardcore.
2. Extract the SimpleWorldTiers folder into your game’s Mods folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.
4. Reach level 10 in a skill and watch for the Wizard’s statue letter.
Works with new and existing saves. In multiplayer, all players should install the same version and edition. The host controls shared tiers and payments; XP belongs to each farmer. Appearance and display choices can be saved locally.
If you previously used Simple Faster Production, remove its old mod folder before launching SWT and carry over your config.json. Supported progression and item records migrate automatically; do not run both mods together.

[heading][color=#9ACAF7]🌍 Compatibility & Languages[/color][/heading]

Keeps native machine inputs, outputs, inventories and job progress. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52954]Simple Harvest Dates[/url] can use SWT’s supported seed and planted-crop timings. Other mods with independently scripted machines, shops or growth systems may need their own integration. Daily-only producers retain their normal daily production rules.
Follows your selected game language: English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish and Hungarian.

[heading][color=#F2C879]🧪 Feedback[/color][/heading]

Automated native-game checks cover both public editions, both SSE level caps, progression, resource and timing hooks, tool energy, monster population and translated menus. Full live multiplayer, long-run balance and wider mod-stack testing remain ongoing.
For a report, include your SMAPI log, SWT edition, active skill tiers and the relevant gameplay or UI mods. Details about what you expected and what happened will help reproduce the issue.
